fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: étude comparative d'outil de revue systématique
fields.quote: we aim to demonstrate LatteReview's practical utility in systematic review applications through two distinct evaluation approaches.

fields.label: Données
fields.value: six article collections from the SYNERGY dataset collection
fields.quote: six different article collections from the SYNERGY dataset collection

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Les modèles utilisés sont GPT‑4O‑mini, Gemini‑1.5‑flash, GPT‑4O, ainsi que des alternatives comme O1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet et Gemini 1.5 Pro.
fields.quote: The workflow comprises two junior reviewers—one powered by Google's Gemini-1.5-flash and another by OpenAI's GPT-4O-mini—both selected for their balance of performance and cost-effectiveness. A senior reviewer agent, utilizing OpenAI's GPT-4O, intervenes only in cases of disagreement between the junior reviewers to make final inclusion decisions. We note that alternative high-performance models such as OpenAI’s O1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, or Gemini 1.5 Pro could also serve effectively in the senior reviewer role.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: Le workflow atteint une exactitude de 0.63, un rappel de 1.0 et une précision de 0.05, avec un AUC de 0.95.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Les systèmes d'IA ont des limites, notamment l'ambiguïté, le manque de contexte ou d'instructions insuffisantes.
fields.quote: While LatteReview offers powerful automation capabilities, it's essential to recognize the limitations inherent in any AI-based system. Even the most advanced LLMs can struggle with certain review items due to factors like ambiguity, lack of context, or insufficient instructions.
